changes: Accepted a standalone BUILD_ISA=n, USE_X86_ISA=n, BUILD_GPU=y PT_LOAD staging target that reuses CP13 image state and the existing memory/lifetime ledgers.

Materialized the locked gfx950 gpuReadWrite image with exact PT_LOAD file copies, BSS zero-fill, descriptor/entry binding, pre-allocation rejection, and shared cross-context lease accounting; retained VEGA_X86 regressions as the compatibility oracle.
Prepared the offline Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B text-only model and a deterministic 15-contract source/registration manifest; added a strict smoke that refuses CPU/NVIDIA fallback.
Built a temporary pinned Triton/LLVM AMD overlay to compile a gfx950 vecadd HSACO; no Triton request or simulator instruction has executed yet.
limitations: CP-0017-A is fixture-scoped staging only. It does not enforce segment permissions, apply relocations, construct dynamic kernarg/AQL, submit a queue, connect HSAPacketProcessor/GPUDispatcher/ComputeUnit, or execute an ISA instruction.
The mapper's negative cases prove pre-allocation malformed/unsupported rejection and shared lifetime behavior; they are not a generic arbitrary-ELF loader or rollback proof.

The Qwen manifest covers the 15 text-only contracts used by the pinned 24-layer model, but static discovery and shape checks are not AMD execution. Full ROCm/OpenCL CTS remains out of scope for this model-specific gate.

The temporary patched Triton probe overlay reaches TTIR/TTGIR/LLIR/AMDGCN/HSACO for gfx950; its CMake graph retains NVIDIA plugin sources and it is not a committed launcher. Triton end-to-end remains 0/1; Qwen inference remains 0/1; no PyTorch/vLLM, hardware, timing, or performance claim is made.

argv: Connect the mapped gfx950 code object to native translation, dynamic kernarg/AQL construction, queue submission, and one real GPU-pipeline differential before the Triton launcher
next_action.expected: A pinned zero-relocation gfx950 dispatch reaches the reused HSAPacketProcessor/GPUCommandProcessor/GPUDispatcher/ComputeUnit path through native translation, uses a descriptor-derived kernel object and ABI-complete kernarg/AQL packet, retires with the exact output/trace oracle, and reports zero CPU fallback. This gate must remain separate from the Triton user launcher.
prerequisites: CP-0017 root checkpoint is accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.
The CP17 gem5 child commit, EV-0042/EV-0043, Qwen model hashes, and 15-contract static manifest remain immutable.
The CP13 fixed-record transport and existing code-object parser remain the ABI authority; unsupported relocations and non-gfx950 targets must be rejected before mapping or publish.
The implementation must preserve the VEGA_X86 reference path and keep AQL/kernarg, instruction execution, and Triton claims separately evidenced.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0017 accepted, preserve the PTLOAD staging executable, Qwen preparation and compile-only Triton evidence, and retain the VEGA_X86 oracle if native translation, packet assembly, or retirement differential fails.
